problems.problem: The brief's third lapidary element, the ivory section slit, is invisible: the rectangle shape at x300,y872,w480,h6 sits behind the product layer and the bottle shoulder (opaque from ~y860) covers it completely, so only two of the three blueprint elements (marquise oval + offset scale oval) read. The narrative is still only two-thirds executed.

The 0.22-opacity lemon scale oval mixes with the cobalt into a desaturated grey-blue halo ring around the cap (visible in image 1 as a muddy grey ellipse edge at roughly x43-108 and x972-1037, y522-898). Against the pure lemon inner oval and ivory ink it reads as a muddy print misregistration rather than the intended enlarged facet scale; the halo needs to stay in the lemon ink family at lower opacity.

Vertical rhythm is still top-loose: title block ends y263, decoration rule y300-306, then ~214px of empty cobalt before the cap top at y520, while the base at y1240 leaves a 200px bottom margin. The nameplate zone floats disconnected from the gem geometry because nothing occupies the y306-520 band.
